rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Gives AI assistants controlled internet access through three tools: web search (via DuckDuckGo, Tavily, or Serper), page fetching with HTML-to-text conversion, and file downloading. Built in Go with a comprehensive security stack including JWT validation against JWKS endpoints, CEL expression-based tool and URL policies, and access logging with header redaction. Supports both stdio and HTTP transport modes with Docker deployment, making it suitable for enterprise environments requiring fine-grained control over which domains and tools each user can access.
